mechanism_narrative: A total nonfarm employment level above 130,000 thousand persons consistently indicates a strong labor market that supports corporate earnings growth and consumer spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when PAYEMS exceeds 130,000 thousand, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 4.0% signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of triggered instances (FEDFUNDS < 4.0%), or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of federal funds rate below 4.0% and CPI inflation below 2.0% indicates a stable monetary environment that reduces real interest rate uncertainty and supports equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when both FEDFUNDS < 4.0% and CPIAUCSL < 2.0%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansions, a declining unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals strong labor market conditions that support corporate earnings growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances during late-cycle expansions with declining UNRATE, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly housing starts level above 2000.0 thousand units indicates a strengthening residential sector that boosts consumer confidence and corporate capital expenditure, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when HOUST exceeds 2000.0, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly industrial production index above 120.0 (2017=100) indicates robust manufacturing activity that supports corporate earnings growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when INDPRO exceeds 120.0, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In post-recession recovery phases, a rising retail sales index (RSAFS) signals strong consumer spending that drives corporate revenue growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances during post-recession recovery phases with rising RSAFS, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate below 5.0% indicates a tight labor market that supports wage growth and consumer spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when UNRATE is below 5.0%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.
